lines.t: Let the trumpet be blown loudly. Let the call to repentance go out. Behold, the trumpet call of God. Come all nations to the end sign raised high.
A standard lift if the sleepers wake
The light shines bright, the heart shall quake
A banner waving the glory unfurls
The King of Heaven calling all the world
From Zion's hill the trumpet sounds
The word of Yahushua spreads all around
A warning, a call, a beacon bright
To draw the faithful into His light
Be a part of the trumpet call
Hear the word, the banner for all
Step forward, beloved, take your stand
Join the call across the land
Yahushua, who reigns on high
The trumpet sounds redemption noise
The nations stir, the plumb line falls
The righteous rises, judgment calls
Oh, a bright lamp post, a shining flame
The trumpet call proclaims His name
Thus says the Lord, beloved
This word, even every volume to every letter
Is the word of my glory
which I have put forth once again a testament of my love and sacrifice the
announcement of my coming a proclamation of truth revelation of who I really am
the trumpet call of God so all those called and chosen may hear and come to
me in their proper time and season behold it is also a strong correction
for all those who have taken to themselves my name and my word to
To pollute it, a plumb line for this wicked generation
For this word is a waving banner, an ensign to all nations
A trumpet of alarm and war, the sound of recompense and judgment
Which shall soon fall upon every nation
For I am who I am
The only begotten of the Father
The one true God and Savior
Savior, the Messiah
Yahushua, Yahuwah
Be a part of the trumpet call
Hear the word, the banner for all
Step forward, beloved, take your stand
Join the call across the land
Yahushua, Yahuwah
The trumpet sounds
Redemption now
Come take your place
In the trumpet call
For behold, the King comes.
